name: Shirasawa Sakuya
source:
Sakuya is introduced to our protagonist as a girl that is looking after the Shirasawa convenience store in the residential area. She eventually reveals herself to be a [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bai_Ze]hakutaku[/url], and proves to be powerful enough to make herself corporeal (unlike other youkai, who can only be seen by Keiji). As a hakutaku, Sakuya has the ability to make predictions and is quite knowledgeable overall.

[From [url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/28990.html]Moroboshi Yuumei's review[/url]]
